nodes.label: Bluehost Sunset, Client Personal Email & @tbr-agent.com Policy
nodes.rationale: Creating thousands of ACA accounts under @ushins.com/@tbri.co triggers CMS Identity Misrepresentation audits and NPN blocks; switching agents to @tbr-agent.com post-OEP saves ~$7,200/yr Google Workspace fees without disrupting carrier contracts mid-season.

Dental / DVH Products (Manhattan Life, Uhone, Medico, NCD, PIVOT, Allstates)
NPN Allocation, Carrier Contract & Weekly IT Audit Rules
nodes.rationale: Enrolling under an agent NPN without an active carrier contract results in $0 commission and exposes the company to legal/compliance liability; weekly IT audits compare HR RTS contracts against CRM submissions to fix mismatches within 24-48h.

nodes.label: Zero-Commission Pitfalls & Member Cap Limits
nodes.rationale: Avoids revenue leakage from carriers paying $0 on new members (Molina 5 states, non-commission states/carriers) or capping member commissions (Oscar max 5, Anthem state caps).

nodes.label: 2027 Authorization (AUT), 9 Consent Forms & 15-Min Link Compliance
nodes.rationale: CMS removed 'Get New Link', enforced 15-minute link expiration and max 3 requests/day, and prohibited bulk sending to prevent SMS quota waste and CMS blacklisting.

nodes.label: ACA Application Claiming, View-Only Trick & Flipping Spouses
nodes.rationale: Creating an independent 2027 app causes CMS mid-December Batch Auto Re-enrollment (BAR) duplicate-app cancellation in January; old applications must be claimed/linked or overwritten directly.

nodes.label: Nov 2026 Rescue Campaign (3,800+ Missing AUT Deals)
nodes.rationale: Splits backlog into Group 1 (Support/Manager direct enroll via existing Healthcare.gov ACA account kept confidential from agents) and Group 2 (Agent/CEO escalation) to prevent losing 50% of 2027 book.

nodes.label: Agent vs Support vs Telesales Boundary & Commission Split (70-30 / 50-50 / $150 Fee)
nodes.rationale: Unlicensed Support is legally prohibited from advising clients or choosing income estimates (to avoid IRS Form 8962 blame); Senior Agents relying on Support for new clients split 50-50 while Renews and New Agents keep 70-30.

nodes.label: HubSpot CRM Data Entry, Deal Cloning & RTE Standards
nodes.rationale: Consistent Agent Owner assignment across 4 modules, 1 Medicare case per Contact, IT batch cloning, and strict RTE checklist/notes prevent commission misattribution and enrollment bottlenecks.

nodes.label: Payment Ticket, Urgent NIC Alert & Cross-Check Audit Policy (QT10)
nodes.rationale: Peer cross-checking of payment tickets prevents rubber-stamping/false closures, quarterly $0 audits verify active status, and urgent NIC payment issue handling carries formal disciplinary warnings.

nodes.label: DMI Verification, No Further Extension, Immigration & Work Permit Dec Strategy
nodes.rationale: Company bans extensions under company NPN to protect NPNs from CMS audit; Work Permit (EAD) cases enroll as Green Card only in December so 90-day DMI spans Q1 2027 (Jan-Mar) and preserves seasonal bonuses.

nodes.label: Multi-Option Solution Matrix (4 Consultation Pillars)
nodes.rationale: Prevents flat refusals on complex immigration/subsidy cases by systematically offering (1) lawful doc fix for Sub, (2) No-Sub ACA, (3) 3-month Sub with risk disclosure, or (4) private non-ACA plans.

nodes.label: Obamacare 2027 Strategy ($0 Premium, Carrier Priority & Household H/A Rules)
nodes.rationale: Targets $0 premium retention and high-bonus carriers: Harbor $0 for no-PCP renews, Ambetter Gold $0 (#1) and Oscar (#2) for new/PCP-driven cases, and flexible quoting for paid plans.

nodes.label: Medicare 2027 Strategy (SOA, Renew Workflow, Overwrite Check & Texas Cheat Sheet)
nodes.rationale: Enforces Manager-only Auto-Renew sign-off, valid prior SOA form before enrollment, Last-App-Wins AEP overwrite checks, and alignment-aware Texas product matching.

nodes.label: HR Weekend Overtime, 13h DST Schedule & EOM Recognition Policy
nodes.rationale: Bans weekday Support OT to preserve health while scheduling weekend OT (9AM-6PM TX = 10PM-7AM VN under 13h DST offset) plus EOM Oct/Nov salary raises.

nodes.label: 60-Day Max Backdate & Own-NPN Backdate Ban
nodes.rationale: Limits backdating to 60 days max and forbids backdating applications already under company/agent NPN to prevent retroactive claim/billing corruption before 2027 renewal.
